correctness.rationale: For a total weak map f, fgf=f iff each image element t is assigned a preimage g(t) that extends to a weak total map. In K_{a,b}, distinct image values in one target part force their preimages into one source part and the other source part to the opposite target part; the 2-value image case has a crossing section. Hence all total weak maps have an inner inverse; the complete/edgeless cases are full transformation monoids. For >=3 parts with one duplicate, the explicit map z1->b, z2->z1, all other vertices->a has adjacent image values b,z1 with unique preimages z1,z2 in one independent part, making every section nonweak. This gives iff and K112 minimum order 4. Independent full monoid/brute inner-inverse enumeration on six small part vectors including K112 (154 maps, 12 nonregular) corroborated the proof.
